candidates.titulo: Google Maps adds agentic features, including food ordering and hotel bookings
candidates.resumen: The launch of these new features reflects Google’s ambitions to transform Google Maps from a navigation tool into an assistant that's capable of helping users complete real-world tasks.

candidates.titulo: OpenAI is giving ChatGPT free users unlimited text chats
candidates.resumen: OpenAI is making a big change for ChatGPT users on its free and Go tiers: Starting next week, users on those tiers will be able to have unlimited text chats with the chatbot, according to OpenAI. Right now, you may run into rate limits if you do too many text chats on those tiers, but those limits, just for text, will be going away soon.
